name: Trois
source:
An omnibus of three stories.

Psychic route
A villain aiming for world conquest awakens the protagonist's hidden power and tries to exploit it. To prevent this, the protagonist's younger sister, Haruno, takes a stand.

Fantasy route
Three girls are, in fact, reincarnations of fairies and youkai. This truth gradually becomes known to the protagonist, and a gentle, understated story unfolds, depicting a love triangle where they are drawn to each other yet remain conflicted.

Witch route
A dark story themed around medieval witch hunts, depicting the persecution and alienation faced by people with abilities different from ordinary humans.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/7544/]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
由三个故事组成的合集。

超能力篇
一个企图征服世界的恶人唤醒主人公潜藏的力量，试图加以利用。为阻止阴谋，主人公的妹妹莲沼はるの挺身而出。

幻想篇
三名女孩其实是妖精与妖怪的转世。主人公逐渐得知真相，一段温柔含蓄的故事随之展开，描绘三人彼此吸引却又内心矛盾的三角恋。

魔女篇
以中世纪猎巫为主题的黑暗故事，描写能力异于常人的人所遭受的迫害与排斥。

[译自 [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/7544/]Getchu[/url]]
